definitions.gloss: cooking method; way of cooking; recipe
definitions.explanation: A technique or approach for preparing food, encompassing specific procedures, heat application, and ingredient handling.

examples.japanese: {料理法|りょうりほう}を{調|しら}べる。
examples.english: To look up a cooking method.

examples.japanese: この{魚|さかな}の{料理法|りょうりほう}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please teach me how to cook this fish.

examples.japanese: {同|おな}じ{食材|しょくざい}でも{料理法|りょうりほう}を{変|か}えると{全|まった}く{違|ちが}う{味|あじ}になる。
examples.english: Even with the same ingredients, changing the cooking method produces a completely different flavor.

notes:
A compound of {料理|りょうり} (cooking; cuisine) and {法|ほう} (method; way). Used to refer to the specific technique or procedure for preparing a dish. Common in cookbooks, recipe sites, and cooking shows.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {料理法|りょうりほう}を{工夫|くふう}する: to devise a cooking method
- {伝統的|でんとうてき}な{料理法|りょうりほう}: traditional cooking method
- {簡単|かんたん}な{料理法|りょうりほう}: easy cooking method
- {料理法|りょうりほう}を{紹介|しょうかい}する: to introduce a cooking method

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {調理法|ちょうりほう}: cooking method — more technical/professional term often used in food science or commercial kitchens
- レシピ: recipe — focuses on the specific step-by-step instructions and ingredient list
- {作|つく}り{方|かた}: way of making — more casual, used in everyday conversation
